blocks.text: Team preview of the Indiana Pacers ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last season: 19-63, missed the playoffs. Coach: Rick Carlisle (11th season with Pacers, 357-381, 26th season overall, 1,012-923). Season opener: Oct. 21 at New Orleans. Departures: Bennedict Mathurin, Isaiah Jackson, Micah Potter. Additions: Ivica Zubac, Kelly Oubre Jr., Larry Nance Jr. What to expect Tyrese Haliburton’s return could change everything for the Pacers. The two-time All-Star hasn’t played since tearing his right Achilles tendon in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals. He says he’s healthy and ready to go, and if he returns to form — or improves […]...
